name: Santen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Santen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and marketing of pharmaceuticals and medical devices in Japan, China, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. The company operates through Medical drugs, Over-the-counter drugs, Medical equipment, and others segments.
